sentences.en: As economy develops, labor-intensive industries give way to capital-intensive industries.
sentences.zh: 随着经济的发展，劳动密集型产业让位于资本密集型产业。

sentences.en: A custom developed in which they would kiss each other.
sentences.zh: 他们之间形成了一种习俗，互相亲吻。

sentences.en: The President decided to provide developing countries with sufficient aid.
sentences.zh: 总统决定向发展中国家提供足够的援助。
